_note: Example Stupp-protocol treatment manifest. All numeric values are PLACEHOLDERS - review before scientific use.
_schedule: Resection at day 10 (seed = day 0); RT 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks starting day 24 (2 weeks post-op); concomitant TMZ on the same 30 days (simplified: TMZ is given daily in the real protocol). NIfTI paths are absolute or relative to this file.
_units: times in days on the solver clock (t=0 = seed), kill_rate and decay_rate in 1/day, dose NIfTI in Gy (TOTAL over all fractions; per-fraction dose = dose/len(times)), alpha in 1/Gy, beta in 1/Gy^2.
